finding.text: The shots don't show this change. They were taken from michael/dev, where `core/System/` doesn't exist yet: /framework/core/System/ is a 404 at all four widths, and Design, Code and UX still render as plain pages with no tab strip (layout.json `tab_rows 0`). Re-shoot from the branch (or after the merge) before any page question can count as a pass. Evidence: shots/monorepo-localhost-framework-core-System/1200.png, "404 — nothing matches"; shots/…-design/1920.png has no Overview · Inbox · Docs strip.

/framework/ai/ was not converted (requirements ask 2). `ai/page.js` and `ai/overview.js` are untouched in the diff, and the new readme and page.js both say "AI is not a System yet". There are no AI shots either, so the asked-for proof (zero console errors on /framework/ai/, /framework/ai/system/, /framework/ai/skills/ and one task page) is missing.
The page.jsonl way is not proven (ask 1: "one real page each way"). The diff has no `page.jsonl` demo under `core/System/`. Only the `page.js` way is exercised.
`system/shape.md` (ask 4) is not in the task folder, so the architect review it was meant to start has nothing to read.

The doc comments are out of step with the code. `code/page.js` says the strip is "Overview · Inbox", but the bar would also show API/Docs/Files whenever they exist. `doc/system.md` lists "Design, Code, UI and UX" while the readme says "five". Minor. Fix them when AI lands.

`core/System/page.js` is a `Doc` that documents the class. It ends with `md.details(readme)` by hand, which is the same readme that the System class appends automatically. That's fine for a Doc, but the page's intro paragraph about `System extends Doc` runs about 90 words (content 3).

Design, UI and UX fail to load at every width: each shows "Page Load Error — (names ?? "").trim is not a function" (requirement 2, "keep what each page shows today"). The Inbox extension replaces `this.notes` with an array, and Doc still reads it as a string. System.js copies the string only into its own `bar()`, so every other place Doc reads `notes` still breaks. Code works because it declares no `notes:`. Evidence: shots/127-0-0-1-54456-framework-{design,ui,ux}/1200.png; layout.json widest_text_sample.

/framework/ai/ is not converted (requirement 2). The readme and page.js both say "AI is not a System yet". The brief allowed AI to go last as its own commit, but it is still missing, and there are no shots of /framework/ai/.
There is no page.jsonl proof (requirement 1, "Prove both: one real page each way"). The diff adds no page.jsonl System page, so the second way is documented but never run.

core/System/page.js shows the five systems as Concepts button tiles, not as live preview cards (requirement 3). The AI tile also sits right above the sentence "AI is not a System yet", so the page contradicts itself. Evidence: shots/127-0-0-1-54456-framework-core-System/1920.png, bands 2–3.
`system/shape.md` does not exist in the task folder (requirement 4).
Every System now gets an Inbox tab. The brief asked for one only when the page carries `{"ext": "Inbox"}`. The change is documented in System.js, but it differs from the brief.

The System page itself is a Doc without `leaf`, so the sidebar lists Overview · API · Docs as if they were child pages (page 9). Its declared Files tab is also absent from the strip. Evidence: shots/127-0-0-1-54456-framework-core-System/1920.png, sidebar under System.
Code at 3440 is one narrow column on an empty screen (82% empty). Before the change it was the same, so this is not a regression (layout 1).

Deliverable 1 asks for proof both ways: "one real page each way", the second a tiny page.jsonl demo under core/System/. The diff has no page.jsonl System page anywhere, so the page.jsonl path (`log_class()`, the `meta`-less `readme()` fallback) is untested.

/framework/ai/ is not converted yet (deliverable 2, second half). It sits in its own sub-task (`system/ai-convert/`), which the brief allows ("do it last, as its own commit"). No AI shot was taken, so the `?v1`, /ai/system/ and /ai/skills/ urls are not proven here.
`system/shape.md` (deliverable 4, the architect's one screen) is not written yet.

The System class page is a Doc, not a leaf, so the site sidebar lists Overview · API · Docs under System as if they were pages (page 9). That is exactly the spill `leaf` prevents on the five systems. Evidence: shots/…core-System/1920.png, sidebar rows under "System".

The System page's first line says the five systems "all share the same tabs … the same Inbox", and the very next paragraph says AI is not a System yet (words 7). The AI tile also links to a page that does not show the shared strip. Evidence: shots/…core-System/1920.png, bands 1–2.

Design and Code are one 640px column on an 80%-empty screen at 3440 (layout 1). That shape existed before this change and the brief said to keep what each page shows, so this is not a regression. Evidence: layout.json empty 0.805 (design) and 0.817 (code) at 3440.
Deliverable 4 is missing: there is no `system/shape.md` (the one screen for the architect), so the class can't go to mastermind-servex-9 for its shape review.

The page.jsonl demo's two tiles link nowhere. `core/System/demo/page.jsonl` gives them the slugs `"x"` and `"y"`, so clicking "Design" or "Code" opens `/framework/core/System/demo/x/`, which isn't a page (requirement 1, "prove both ways"). Point them at `/framework/design/` and `/framework/code/` with `href`.

The new System page spills its tabs into the site sidebar. `core/System/page.js` is a plain `Doc` without `leaf: true`, so the sidebar lists Demo · Overview · API · Docs under System as if they were pages. This is the exact spill that `ui/page.js` used to guard against (shots/…core-System/1200.png, left sidebar under "System").

The demo page never says what it is until you open the folded Readme. Its Overview is two tiles, a closed "Readme" and a file tree, with no sentence. Most of the panel is empty: layout.json shows `big_empty` at 400, 1920 and 3440 and empty 77–89% (shots/…core-System-demo/sheet.png). Add the description line as content.

AI is not converted in this diff. The page says so and the work moved to its own subtask (`system/ai-convert/`), which the brief allows ("do it last, as its own commit"). This review covers deliverables 1 and 3 and the four other systems, not AI's urls.
The brief asks for the five systems as "live preview cards" on `core/System/page.js`. The page draws Concepts tiles (buttons) instead. That is consistent with the tiles but it is not a preview.

The core/System page shows the five systems as small icon chips, not as "live preview cards" the way ask 3 says (requirements 3). Evidence: shots/…-core-System/1920.png, top band, five Concepts chips and no previews.

The page.jsonl demo (the one proof of "both ways") is a mostly empty screen: 77–89% empty, and `tab-panel` is flagged big_empty at 400, 1920 and 3440. Its only words are folded inside "Readme". It shows a second, vertical tab strip (Overview · Inbox) inside the parent's Demo tab. Its page.jsonl source line runs past the edge of the code pane and is cut off. (page 9, layout 7, wrapping 24.) Evidence: shots/…-core-System-demo/1920.png.

AI is not converted in this diff (requirements 2). It sits in its own commit, 63f499cb on worktree/ui-system, which is not merged, and there is no /framework/ai/ shot. Meanwhile core/System `page.js` and `readme.md` say "AI is not a System yet". Those lines must change in the same merge as 63f499cb, or the page goes stale the moment AI lands.

The concept tiles get their own `.pad` (`div.c("pad system-concepts")`) inside a page that already pads. At 400 the tiles start about 14px to the right of the text below them (shots/…-code/400.png, top band). This is padding counted twice (spacing 34/35).

At 3440 every converted page is one narrow column on a mostly empty screen: empty 0.81 Design, 0.82 Code, 0.77 System, 0.73 UX (layout 1). The Doc frame had this shape before the diff. All five pages now share one class, so a single fix in System would improve all of them.

The proof the brief asks for is partly missing: there are no "before" shots and no /framework/ai/ shots. Widths given: 400, 1200, 1920 and 3440 for design, code, ui, ux, core, core/System and core/System/demo.

The Demo tab of /framework/core/System/ draws a second tab strip, so the tabs run to 2 rows at 1920 and 3440 (navigation 2); its panel is also nearly empty: two tiles, a folded readme and a file pane, with big_empty set at 400, 1920 and 3440 (layout 7). Evidence: shots/127-0-0-1-53957-framework-core-System-demo/layout.json, tab_rows 2 at 1200, 1920 and 3440.

/framework/ai/ is not a System yet, so ask 2 is only partly met by this diff. shape.md says it lands separately as the `ai-convert` sub-task, which the brief allows ("do it last, as its own commit"). The task should not land as done until that sub-task does.

On Design at 3440 the five concept tiles wrap and leave "UI" alone on a second row (layout 11). The tile row is capped at the reading column while 81% of the screen is empty. Evidence: shots/…-framework-design/3440.png, top band.
Design and Code stay one narrow column at 3440 (82% empty) (layout 1). This is not new: the brief said to keep what each page shows today.

"AI is not a System yet" is written into core/System/page.js and readme.md as fixed text. It goes stale the moment ai-convert lands. The `System extends Doc` paragraph on that page runs about 85 words (content 3).
The demo page.jsonl gives its tiles the slugs "x" and "y". It works, because `href` overrides them, but anyone who copies the demo copies meaningless names.

AI is not a System in this diff (requirement 2): `ai/page.js` and `ai/overview.js` are untouched. The conversion exists as its own commit, 63f499cb on worktree/ui-system (ai-convert/task.jsonl), but it is not part of what was reviewed. Meanwhile the diff ships text saying the opposite: core/System/page.js says "AI is not a System yet" and readme.md says "AI: pending". Land 63f499cb together with this change and update both sentences, or the page will be wrong as soon as it merges.

The demo page (the proof for page.jsonl) has a big empty band (layout 7). layout.json gives `big_empty` true on the tab-panel at 400, 1920 and 3440. In shots/…core-System-demo/1920.png, the Files box is about 480px tall and holds two file names, and the page.jsonl line is cut off at the right edge of the viewer (widest_text 2153). There is also no sentence saying what the demo is: `left_stack.p` is 0 at every width.
The Design tiles break onto a second row with only "UI" on it, even at 3440 (layout 11). See shots/…framework-design/sheet.png, top band.
On the core/System Overview, the paragraph that starts "`System extends Doc`…" runs about 75 words (content 3). It also repeats what readme.md and doc/system.md already say.
On the demo, `tab_rows` is 2 at 1200 and 1920. The bar it measured is the nested vertical Overview · Inbox list, which is vertical by design, so this is not a wrapped tab bar.
